info.title: PEA Tracker REST API
info.description: Financial Instruments REST contract. Default Worker exposes health and MCP ping only. Instruments are implemented for isolated synthetic apps and the explicit loopback-only HTTP harness; no public instrument exposure or selected OAuth provider. Dated opening-state revisions and position reads are implemented only in explicitly injected local synthetic compositions; Access authentication and deployed entrypoints are unchanged. Quotation provenance, immutable local ingestion and REST/MCP read capabilities are explicitly injected local synthetic features; no collector or valuation.

x-auth-policy: Private endpoints require approved authentication, verified owner/API audience and operation-specific permissions before any public exposure. Default app has diagnostics only; synthetic principals are injected in tests, never selected by HTTP headers.
x-first-adapter: Memory per isolated application instance, plus native D1 in explicitly isolated local synthetic tooling. D1 atomically persists original create outcomes and optimistic versions across tested local process restarts; no remote recovery or production authentication evidence. The public Worker remains diagnostic-only.
x-http-policy: Instrument responses are no-store/nosniff without permissive CORS. Authenticate/authorize before repository access. Mutation body limit 16 KiB. Unknown/repeated query parameters rejected. Undeclared methods on mounted instrument routes return authenticated 405 with Allow; HEAD is explicitly rejected rather than inherited from GET. Errors use application/problem+json; safe request IDs only. Portfolio opening-state requests are separately bounded at 128 KiB; its POST always requires If-Match (0 for the first revision).

200.description: Catalog page in ID ascending order; no snapshot guarantee across writes.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Single base-10 integer value; unknown and repeated query parameters rejected.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Only literal true/false accepted; omitted means all records.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque versioned base64url cursor binding last ID and active filter; invalid or mismatched cursor returns 400.

201.description: Created, or exact replay of original create outcome.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same subject/operation/key and canonical input replays original 201; changed input returns 409. Outcomes persist only for app-instance lifetime in the first adapter.

parameters.name: If-Match

No automatic grant mapping from existing OAuth/Access identities.

get.description: Current declared opening positions only. Cursor pins an immutable revision across corrections. No ledger, valuation, inferred total cost or historical performance; no arbitrary as_of support. Unknown/repeated query parameters rejected.

200.description: Authorized synthetic/local quotation read with explicit provenance and freshness boundaries.

get.description: Successful provider observations, inclusive market-time window <=366 days, ordered market_timestamp/fetched_at/id. Required full selector; cursor bound to normalized selector/window. No automatic corporate-action adjustment. Immutable observations, not a frozen multi-page snapshot under concurrent backfills.

200.description: Authorized synthetic/local quotation read with explicit provenance and freshness boundaries.

get.description: Explicit provider/kind/adjustment selector; no automatic feed selection. Failure retains last successful observation and successful fetch timestamp. Collection, market age and provider delay are distinct; no realtime guarantee. Market context is server-side, unknown by default.

201.description: Accepted immutable batch, or original durable replay.

requestBody.description: 128 KiB limit; all-or-nothing batch <=50 observations. Collector/provider/instrument grants are server-configured; admin/read do not imply ingestion. Conflict under selector/fetched_at fails atomically; exact duplicate observations reuse original IDs. No remote collector is installed.

get.description: Explicit provider/kind, no fallback or FX. Stale/delayed/unknown observations remain labelled estimates. Missing prices excluded; partial subtotal never a complete total. Exact sums before half-even EUR display. Pins opening revision and quote IDs, not an atomic cross-instrument snapshot. Only explicitly injected local composition.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: Opening revision only; not a historical quotation as_of.

200.description: EUR estimate with exact inputs, partial coverage, cash knowledge and freshness warnings. No realtime guarantee or performance.

BearerAuth.description: Explicit protected local composition validates RS256 access JWTs against pinned issuer/JWKS, route audience, exact owner/client and delegated scope ceilings. Default Worker remains diagnostic-only; live Auth0 integration is unverified.

quote_currency.description: Uppercase code syntax only; no registry, coverage or FX assertion.

price_unit.description: Quotation unit metadata; no conversion calculation in this slice.

x-oauth-local-policy: MCP requires mcp:read and portfolio:read on its audience; REST read/admin require portfolio:read/portfolio:admin on a separate audience. Discovery: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/v1. No authorization server or public financial routes are enabled.
